# GitHub Copilot instructions

**All coding, documentation, and testing conventions for this repository live in
[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). Read that file before suggesting or making any edit.**

Condensed essentials — the full rules and rationale are in `AGENTS.md`:

- **Java** (`/mod`): 4-space indent, K&R braces, Javadoc on every public symbol, `final`
  fields, `@SerializedName("snake_case")` on serialized fields. Never let logging crash
  the game; no empty catch blocks.
- **Python** (`/nn`, `/rl`): Black (line-length 88), ruff (incl. pydocstyle `D`), mypy with
  `disallow_untyped_defs = true`. Google-style docstrings. `from __future__ import
  annotations` in every module.
- **JavaScript** (`/rl/bridge`): 2-space indent, single quotes, semicolons, CommonJS,
  Node's built-in `node:test` — no new test dependencies.
- **Every file** starts with an SPDX header (`SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT`), ends with a
  single newline, and has no trailing whitespace.
- **Never** commit `/bot/`, `mod/webhook.txt`, or any `.env` — these are gitignored and
  contain live secrets or private logic.
- **Never** weaken a lint/type/test gate to make it pass, and never leave an open `TODO`;
  document limitations in `KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md` instead.
- Changing the JSONL session schema requires bumping `schema_version` **and** updating
  `mod/README.md`, `/nn`'s schema registry, `/rl`'s schema copy, and `/bot`'s validator.
  See `AGENTS.md` §7.

## PR descriptions

When creating a pull request, add this footer at the very end of the PR body:

```
Generated by GitHub Copilot
```
